basic_info.description: This sunny 2BD/2BA residence offers a front-row seat to life in the Marina. South-facing bay windows frame vibrant views of Francisco Street, filling the space with natural light throughout the day. Enjoy being just minutes from Chestnut Street, Fort Mason, the Marina Green & public transit. The building has undergone a comprehensive renovation, with structural, seismic, electrical. 400-amp electrical system, new central fire alarm & sprinkler systems in common areas, shear walls, structural beams & seismic strengthening from the roof to the foundation. Inside, the open-concept layout is anchored by a chef's kitchen featuring ss appliances, a 6-burner range, quartz countertops & sleek cabinetry. The airy living and dining areas create a warm & inviting setting for everyday living or entertaining. The tranquil primary suite has a walk-in closet & spa-like ensuite bath. A second bedroom with a nearby full bath provides the perfect space for guests, a nursery or office. Additional highlights include in-unit w/d, generous storage, recessed lighting, central heating & access to a shared backyard with BBQ. NOT in liquefaction! Leased parking available nearby for ~$350/mo. Photos are of different unit in building.
